name: browser-use
headline: Create Claude skills with specialized tool
short_description: Creates and manages Claude Code skills with proper structure, naming conventions, and YAML frontmatter. For developers building skill templates and understanding skill anatomy.
author: grub-404

sections.overview:
This skill automates the creation and management of Claude Code skills by providing structured templates, naming conventions, and validation rules. It guides developers through skill anatomy—from simple documentation-only skills to complex skills with Python scripts—while enforcing best practices like gerund naming, third-person descriptions, and progressive content disclosure. The skill includes helper scripts to scaffold new skills, list existing ones, and manage skill versioning through YAML frontmatter. It solves the problem of inconsistent skill structure and reduces setup time for developers building AI agent capabilities.
Scaffold new documentation-only skills with SKILL.md templates
Create complex skills with run.py, list.py, and cleanup.py scripts
Validate skill naming conventions and frontmatter requirements
Generate skills from user requests describing automation needs
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/grub-404/claude-skill-skill`

